reviews.author: Rhonda Edwards
reviews.text: Carmelo was the best! My husband Shelton broke down on I-95 at the Hardeeville exit. Allen’s Towing recommended J and C and towed the truck there for him. Carmelo did not disappoint. He listened to what Shelton said happened, got right down under the truck and then took it for a ride and instantly knew what was wrong. Was able to fix it within 30 minutes and he was a super busy guy. Got him back on the road but told him something else needed looked at (but was safe to drive the 3 hours home). Price was very reasonable. If we lived closer he would be our mechanic for sure. With Allen’s Towing and J and C auto Hardeeville, SC had two gems for sure.

reviews.author: Crystal Sarchiapone
reviews.text: Carmelo is amazing. We broke down heading to FL from MD and had to be towed to his shop. He fixed our car at a reasonable price and saved our trip. If we lived closer he’d be our regular mechanic.

reviews.author: Zachary Louis
reviews.text: Ended up with a dead idler pulley on a road trip. The guys at J&C were able to replace it and get me back on the road in no time!

reviews.author: Jennifer Holyer
reviews.text: Can’t say enough good things about the service, price, and excellent work of this shop! An unexpected repair that could have cost hundreds more was handled quickly, professionally, and affordably. J & C Auto has integrity, skill and amazing hospitality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Cody Owens
reviews.text: James is awesome! These guys are always busy and they still somehow get you in and out of there. I just had my front brakes done and they got me in and out in about an hour. Very well done. It's not your typical chain shop that is only interested in selling you what you didn't ask for. Knowledgeable and trustworthy. Best shop in town by far. Price is also the most fair.

reviews.author: Mtnvibes
reviews.text: This shop is far from the most aesthetically pleasing shops you can come across. Sometimes that can definitely give you an idea on what you can expect. However, James is honest, straight forward, and a hard worker. He will do only what is necessary and will do it as quickly as he can. We travel the country and live on the road full time. My left front brake caliper on my Ford f-350 dually was going bad. James verified my issue and then had the new caliper in hand the next morning and had the truck completed by mid afternoon that day. Work done correctly and haven’t had any issue since. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jared Hinerman
reviews.text: I had mistaken added about a gallon gasoline to my diesel tank before I caught my mistake at the pump. J&C immediately knew what steps needed to be taken. I was visiting a friend in the area and was only scheduled to be in the area for a long weekend. They were able to drain and back flush my fuel rail and replace my fuel filter within 24 hours and keep me on schedule. 10/10 would recommend and can’t thank them enough. Price was very fair considering the work and short timeline, didn’t feel like I was being taken advantage for needing urgent service.

reviews.author: Ken Levine
reviews.text: J and C auto truly knows what customer service is and obviously goes above and beyond to deliver it. I broke down on the Saturday after thanksgiving going from N. Carolina to Florida. From the moment we pulled in James made us feel confident that he would take care of our problem. While we waited for them to pick up a special part available only in Georgia at that time, they kept us updated and made sure we were safe and comfortable ( they even sent out for coffee for my wife ). They fixed our RV once all the parts were there quickly and reasonably. Both James and Carmelo stayed long after closing ( on a Saturday night after the holiday ) to help us get back on the road. I hope you never break down in S.Carolina but if you do I hope you are lucky enough to get to J and C. James and Carmelo made us feel like family. Thanks again guys.

reviews.author: Laurie Towler
reviews.text: My '68 Firebird broke down right across the street from J & C. Within minutes of of talking to him Carmello had my car on his flatbed and took it down the street to my regular repair shop for a very fair price. Both of my car/towing contacts had good things to say about J & C. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Chris Powers
reviews.text: We just crossed over into South Carolina on our way north when our truck started to misfire and sputter! Oh! No! We just left Florida for our family vacation this morning. Thank goodness we found J and C Auto and Diesel! James diagnosed the problem as a spark plug issue and set about fixing. He did all this with a friendly and efficient manner. I don't have words for our appreciation of the nice service we received so late in the day on a Friday afternoon. Thank you guys for being available to help and to James especially for keeping it light and teaching us some new tricks!

reviews.author: Eric Garza
reviews.text: A few weeks ago, I was passing through S. Carolina from Florida and unfortunately got a a nail in my tire. Some local guys led me to this spot. Even though there were probably several cars ahead, the guy in the front office saw I had my three year old with me and took care of the flat. He also pointed out to me I had a bubble on the rim wall and encouraged me to observe it. True to his word, my car started shaking and I detoured to change the tire. The bubble had grown from a small gum ball size to twice the size and was ready to blow. I can’t thank him enough for taking care of the flat and the advice. He charged me $10 to repair the flat, and his honesty was priceless. Thank you again for the help!

reviews.author: Lee Mercado
reviews.text: We had an emergency on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, heading back home to Florida. They were the only mechanics open for miles, and fit us in immediately. They were honest, knowledgeable, fast and fairly priced. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nicholas Moody
reviews.text: Now that I’m home, I can take a minute and give a proper shout out to the guys at J and C Auto & Tire service in Hardeeville, SC. You just don’t find shops like this anymore. They are a “neighborhood” garage. The guys had like four techs there and they never stopped the whole time I was there. They were so busy that after the wrong part showed up, the owner gave me the keys to his car, let me go run the parts down, and had no issue with me fixing the car myself in their shop! They even bought me lunch. Good old South Carolina gearhead hospitality! So, if you are ever happen to be going trough Hardeeville or nearby and need an awesome shop, these guys are the real deal! James and Carmelo has one last request.... that I did one last burnout on my way down the road.

reviews.author: Jake Rouse Taxidermy
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would!! JC and James are the best around!! My husband, myself, and 3 kids (2 of them are 2 and under), were traveling from NC to Fl headed to Disney World. We stopped at an exit off 95 to get gas, and when we went to leave the gas station my transmission in my tahoe went out! We called around and were given JC's number and told he would do us right....well that is 100% true! He immediately sent over James to help us... he looked it over and determined it was the transmission and helped us get our tahoe over to the shop, 2 miles away. We finally found a rental car available to fit all of us (apparently it was a busy day to rent a car near there!), but we finally found one! We were sitting in my tahoe at JC's shop, and he came over to check on us to see if we had found a rental car....my husband told him yes and he was about to get a taxi or Uber to get to the airport to pick it up (17 miles away)....JC never hesitated and said no, get in the car I will take you! ....JC & James both came and checked on me and the kids several times to see if we needed anything to drink, a restroom, etc until my husband got back with the rental car (which took awhile cause Avis car rental was a horrible experience). They even stayed after closing to make sure my husband got back to us, and we weren't left stranded. We finally got the rental car and left, headed to Disney World. My husband tried to give JC some money for his time (helping us all afternoon), but JC would not take a dime from us!! ...He texted us the next day with a price for a brand new transmission with a warranty on it...and it was a better price than what our good friend back home could do! So JC put the new transmission in my tahoe while we were in Disney, and we picked it up on the way back home! Tahoe drives great since picking it up!! We were SO lucky to have found a wonderful, honest mechanic!! JC and James were absolute Angels to us and I don't know what we would have done without them!! I cannot recommend them enough!!!! ~April

reviews.author: Bob Garbo
reviews.text: Had Emergency car problems and James worked us in, tested items, and we were able to make it safely back home to Ohio. Excellent skills and generosity to help folks in trouble.

reviews.author: Emily L
reviews.text: Sorry i'm about two months late with this review. Dudes here are awesome! I showed up 20 mins before closing with a shredded tire and no key for my tires bolts. The got it off and replaced it even tho they had to stay late (i'm from out of town i do not live there so that was a life saver.) Appreciate you guys so much.

reviews.author: Jameifer williams
reviews.text: And if I could I'd a 10 star rating..when I tell you an honest person who genuinely wants to fix your problem and not look for more to upcharge you..this is the place.I honestly pray for the wellbeing of James because we need more people that then become mechanics for the sole reason of it and nothing else. Thank you always for the honest good job.

reviews.author: Terrance Wahl
reviews.text: my car broke down on my way home to atlanta and I found them online and had my car towed to them. they immediately diagnosed my problem even thought they were about to close...and then they fixed everything promptly and were easy and friendly to deal with. I got home safely and am extremely grateful i found these guys

reviews.author: tina frazier
reviews.text: Thank you for taking the time to help my family member in distress.... You went above and beyond to make sure she was safe and stayed cool in the extreme heat while you worked on her vehicle. Your action speak volumes and I'm grateful to you and your staff.

reviews.author: Pretty Flor
reviews.text: Best service in Hardeeville these guys know a lot about any vehicle. Wait time is about 1/2 for battery change out. I would recommend to family and friends.

reviews.author: Liz Schreiber
reviews.text: These guys are the best. Super honest, efficient, fast, friendly, talented. All-around good people. James and Carmelo do great work the right way.

reviews.author: Timothy Padgett
reviews.text: I called them at 1:30pm for recked service and they accommodated me by 5pm with affordable service and took my truck to the destination I asked. Polite and professional.

reviews.author: Zak Smith
reviews.text: Awesome shop, fair price, very professional, and honest. Got us in and out, would definitely bring my car back.

reviews.author: Letty Robles
reviews.text: I have been here twice and every time Mr Carmelo has been great very knowledgeable, other places see your plates out of state and they want to take advantage of it, not here he’s service and prices are real good!

reviews.author: J EJames
reviews.text: Completely unprofessional and filthy unkempt property. No structure no safety concerns, absolutely should be avoided. Keep driving til you reach a different repair location.

reviews.author: Helder Castellanos
reviews.text: Dishonest Shop. Will lie (James especially) just to get you in & out and charge you money without ever fixing the problem. Dont waste your time & money here, there are far better shops in town.

reviews.author: Douglas Schreiber
reviews.text: Have been going there for years. James and Carmello couldn't be friendlier! Always good work and a fair price.

reviews.author: Jason Jiminez
reviews.text: Great place to have your vehicle fixed Mr.Carmelo knows what he is doing and he has a great staff helping him out also take your vehicle in there for anything they can fix it

reviews.author: Jamie Ward
reviews.text: Dropped by this place on a Saturday evening with a front tire going down...these guys took great care of fixing my problem and got me back on the road...they stay busy..so be patient with them.

reviews.author: LaToyia Banks
reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Not many mechanics. So... If it's not a simple fix, your vehicle will be will be placed waayy in the back and forgotten.

reviews.author: Dustin Payne
reviews.text: Stands for James and Carmelo Auto and Diesel Services. They are the best shop from 100 miles around.

reviews.author: ojwret48
reviews.text: Once they get your car they keep for along time and never fix it. Never will i bring any car to this shop.
